mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.staff_members (id, staff_code, full_name, date_of_birth, sex, phone, email, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{staffCode}, #{fullName}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{sex}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(substr(staff_code, char_length(#{prefix}) + 1) AS bigint)), 0) FROM public.staff_members WHERE starts_with(staff_code, #{prefix}) AND substr(staff_code, char_length(#{prefix}) + 1) ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
mapper.sql:
FROM public.staff_members s LEFT JOIN public.accounts a ON a.staff_member_id = s.id AND a.account_type = 'STAFF' LEFT JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = a.role_id
s.staff_code ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR s.full_name ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR a.username ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\'
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.staff_code, s.full_name, s.date_of_birth, s.sex, s.phone, s.email, s.status, s.row_version, a.id AS account_id, a.username, a.status AS account_status, r.code AS role_code, a.row_version AS account_row_version
ORDER BY
s.staff_code DESC, s.id DESC s.staff_code ASC, s.id ASC s.full_name DESC, s.id DESC s.full_name ASC, s.id ASC s.id DESC s.id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
